_doc: Pinned TKA domain-term translations. POLICY (research-backed 2026-06-20): brand/proper-noun identity stays Latin in EVERY locale (_keepEnglish). All other domain terms render in native script — Latin-script locales keep the English word where it reads fine (es/fr/de/pt/it), CJK transliterate (ja/ko katakana/hangul), Chinese translates to meaning, Cyrillic/Arabic transliterate or translate. ko/ar + some zh term-of-art words marked TODO/low-confidence — need a native pass.

Codex._ja_note: glossary section 1 keeps Codex Latin; departs from the old 図鑑 pin (4 strings changed)
